name: Baltrice
description: Tezzeret's second-in-command in the Infinite Consortium who set up safehouses.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels across planes already overrun by Phyrexians, finding Baltrice's safehouses compromised.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn's "great work" was unfolding faster than Tezzeret could have imagined.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret finds Baltrice's safehouse behind a gaming parlor and gathers supplies.
timeline.quote: Inside, he found exactly what he was looking for.

pages_say.description: Tezzeret's second-in-command in the Infinite Consortium who set up safehouses.
